entry.title: Announcing 4chan's Vulnerability Disclosure Program
entry.content: In response to last month’s intrusion , we’ve put numerous additional security measures in place in an effort to mitigate and prevent future intrusions. We’re also pleased to announce the creation of 4chan's Vulnerability Disclosure Program —commonly known as a “bug bounty.” We hope that by providing an officially sanctioned way for security researchers to submit security-related bugs, we’ll be in a better position to detect and respond to vulnerabilities that may impact the site and its users.
